content.text:
force_change=false
=== API basic auth ===
users/me HTTP 401
{"_type":"Error","errorIdentifier":"urn:openproject-org:api:v3:errors:Unauthenticated","message":"You did not provide the correct credentials."}
=== API root (authenticated) ===
api/v3 HTTP 401
{"_type":"Error","errorIdentifier":"urn:openproject-org:api:v3:errors:Unauthenticated","message":"You did not provide the correct credentials."}

observation.command:
docker exec openproject bash -c 'cd /app && bundle exec rails runner "
u = User.find_by(login: %q(admin))
u.force_password_change = false
u.save!
puts %q(force_change=) + u.force_password_change.to_s
"' 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO --"
echo "=== API basic auth ==="
curl -s -u admin:AdminPass12345! -H "Accept: application/json" -o /tmp/me.json -w "users/me HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/api/v3/users/me
head -c 400 /tmp/me.json; echo
echo "=== API root (authenticated) ==="
curl -s -u admin:AdminPass12345! -H "Accept: application/json" -o /tmp/root.json -w "api/v3 HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/api/v3
head -c 200 /tmp/root.json
